UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Messages_ToDoReequip: Items will now be re-equipped after actions.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Messages_ToDoNotReequ: Items will no longer be re-equipped after actions.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_UseContextMen: Show Re-Equip Toggle in Context Menu
Adds an option to the context menu that enables or disables automatic re-equipping after actions.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_ForceReequip_: By default, interrupted actions do not restore your equipment. Enable this option to restore only the items that were in your hands before the action.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman: Returns materials obtained by dismantling an item to the container the dismantled item came from.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T: Controls diagnostic output for troubleshooting. Detailed logging may affect performance, so enable it only while reproducing an issue.
